column1: #This file contains input necessary to run the simulations required to generate Chart 80
#Chart 80 shows a time series of the flow reduction at The Dalles for specified groups of projects
#In the Chart 80 approach, groups of projects are incrementally added to the unreg run to determine the flow reduction to the project groups
#While this might not be the very best approach, it is what has historically been done, so we want to be consistent
#This same method can be used for other applications aside from Chart 80--this process is generalized to be able to run any group of projects desired.
#The first column contains the names of the junctions at which to save output from the simulations (typically just "The Dalles_OUT")
#Each subsequent column represents a separate simulation
#   The first row is the name of the simulation that the results will be saved as (f-part)
#   The list of projects below each column are the projects to include in the simulation. They will be operated to the "observed" operation
#   All projects not in the list will operate as they did in the unregulated simulation (typically pass inflow, but if a natural lake, then natural lake operations will be modeled)
#   The projects can be reservoir names or diversion names (separating the influence of the Upper Snake Diversions is often desired)
#All names must match the ResSim model exactly
#The order of projects is consistent with what had been done in the SSARR model originally (in the May 2014 SOP documentation)
#Inconsistencies abound in which projects are included in each incremental run, but this is how it's been done historically
